findings.remediation: AI worker jobs must cover RAG retrieval, OCR recognition, and fine-tuning as isolated worker capabilities.
RAG/OCR/training work must stay behind the Python worker boundary.
AI worker jobs must not make model, OCR, RAG, or training packages baseline runtime dependencies.
Workers must return artifacts through the boundary rather than writing directly to the main database.
Worker jobs must declare node type, data access, inputs, and output policy.
Worker results must prove that no direct main database write was attempted.
Worker results must return artifact references, not inline private payloads.
Every example job must stay behind the isolated worker boundary.
Examples must cover RAG retrieval, OCR recognition, and fine-tuning.

findings.expected: cloud jobs only use PUBLIC_KNOWLEDGE and no student data
findings.remediation: Cloud workers must not receive private knowledge or student archive data.

findings.expected: at least one cloud RAG job over PUBLIC_KNOWLEDGE
findings.remediation: Examples must prove that cloud RAG remains limited to public knowledge.

findings.expected: remote-device jobs do not use local private knowledge or local student archives
findings.remediation: Remote-device workers may use their own knowledge, not this machine's private knowledge base or student archive.

findings.expected: local private RAG, local OCR, and local fine-tuning examples
findings.remediation: Local worker examples must prove the private-data paths stay local.
Result example must demonstrate artifact references only.
